verified_facts.text: Mondrian Cannes is at 45 Boulevard de la Croisette, steps from the Mediterranean shore and minutes from the Palais des Festivals et des Congres.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steps from the shore of the Mediterranean Sea, minutes from the Palais des Festivals et des Congrès and yet seemingly in a world unto its own, Mondrian Cannes is a modern French retreat designed to inspire.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is about a 5 minute walk from the Palais des Festivals.
verified_facts.excerpt: 5 minute walk from the Palais des Festivals

verified_facts.text: The hotel is about 30 minutes by car from the airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: 30 minutes by car from airport

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are spread across eleven floors above Boulevard de la Croisette, beside the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Across eleven floors sitting above Boulevard de la Croisette and beside the Mediterranean Sea, 75 rooms and suites show the elegant side of modernity.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have curved lines of soft, aqua-hued flooring, with modern design shaped by the seaside setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: The curved cleaned lines of soft, aqua-hued flooring set a stage for modern design enlivened by a sea-side setting and tempered by sophistication in our rooms.

verified_facts.text: Suites are inspired by the calm of the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suites are infused with a dreamlike sensibility, inspired by the fresh calm of the Mediterranean.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe City View rooms are on the top floor, with views over the town of Cannes and the surrounding hills, in a palette of light blue-green and white with black frame detailing and fluted deco-style sconces.
verified_facts.excerpt: With views over the town of Cannes and the surrounding hills, Deluxe Room City View accommodations are located on the top floor of the hotel. A palette of light blue-green and white is made crisp with black frame detailing

verified_facts.text: Prestige Sea View Terrace rooms have a furnished private sea-facing terrace and a bathroom with marble shower or bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: bathroom with marble shower or bathtub and a furnished, 7m² private sea-facing terrace.

verified_facts.text: The Panoramic Terrace room is on the top floor overlooking the Croisette and the sea, with a private spa on its sea-facing terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the top floor, overlooking the Croisette and the sea, the 85m2 Panoramic Room boasts a private spa on the terrace facing the sea.

verified_facts.text: The Signature Suites are on the top floor, the highest point on the Croisette, with views of the bay of Cannes from a private furnished terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the top floor, the highest point on the Croisette, the 65m² Signature Suites offer breath-taking views of the bay of Cannes from its 20m², private furnished terrace.

verified_facts.text: The Serenity Suite is on the top floor with a terrace facing the hills of the countryside and overlooking the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the top floor of Mondrian Cannes, the Serenity Suite inspires calm, both in its clean modern design and its expansive a 20m² terrace, facing the hills of the countryside and overlooking the city.

verified_facts.text: Hyde Beach Cannes is the hotel's private beach restaurant, set on the sandy beach along La Croisette, serving an Italian menu with a casual daytime and lively evening atmosphere.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the sandy beach along the legendary boulevard de La Croisette, Hyde Beach Cannes offers a casual daytime and lively evening atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Guests have exclusive access to Hyde Beach Cannes, the hotel's private beach restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mondrian Cannes enjoys a prime beachfront location directly on La Croisette, with exclusive access to Hyde Beach Cannes, our private beach restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Mr. Nakamoto is the hotel's Asian-inspired restaurant and bar, pairing local and seasonal ingredients with Asian flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: An elevated menu of prized local and seasonal ingredients meets an array of intricate and intriguing Asian flavors at Mr. Nakamoto Cannes.

verified_facts.text: In the summer season Hyde Beach Cannes has daily DJ sets, and Mr. Nakamoto has evening DJ sets.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the summer season, daily DJ sets are featured at Hyde Beach Cannes, and evening DJ sets are also offered at Mr. Nakamoto.

verified_facts.text: The concierge arranges bespoke Riviera experiences including private Cote d'Azur tours, excursions to the Lerins Islands and private boat rentals.
verified_facts.excerpt: including private tours of the Côte d’Azur, excursions to the Lérins Islands, private boat rentals, and recommendations for the best local dining and cultural experiences.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a Les Clefs d'Or concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Les Clefs d'Or Concierge

verified_facts.text: Every Saturday morning Hyde Beach Cannes hosts the Hyde Boxing Club workout by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every Saturday morning, Hyde Beach Cannes invites you to enjoy a unique workout experience right by the sea.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not currently have an on-site spa; the concierge can arrange appointments at nearby spas in Cannes.
verified_facts.excerpt: does not currently have an on-site spa or wellness center. However, our concierge team is happy to recommend and arrange appointments at nearby spa facilities in Cannes.

verified_facts.text: Children under 12 stay and have breakfast free when sharing their parents' room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children under 12 years old stay and enjoy breakfast complimentary when sharing their parents’ room.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly, at an additional charge per animal per night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Mondrian Cannes is a pet-friendly hotel. Your furry friends are welcome to share your room at an additional charge of €45 per night, per animal.

verified_facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Mondrian Cannesoffers 24-hour room service, 7 days a week.

verified_facts.text: Ferry services to the Lerins Islands depart from a nearby pier.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ferry services to the Lérins Islands depart from a nearby pier, offering a scenic escape from the city.

verified_facts.text: Parking is available at a daily charge and should be arranged in advance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, parking is available at Mondrian Cannes at a cost of €35 per day. Please contact our team in advance to arrange your parking space.

verified_facts.text: Mondrian Cannes is certified by Green Globe as a Gold Member for 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mondrian Cannes is certified by Green Globe as a Gold Member for 2026.

verified_facts.text: Every Sunday Mr. Nakamoto hosts a brunch with Asian-inspired flavours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every Sunday, Mr. Nakamoto at Mondrian Cannes hosts an elegant brunch experience, featuring Asian-inspired flavours in a refined and welcoming setting on the Croisette.
